6.3  Roles as regards data needs 
Clients, project developers, contractors and producers are all involved 
in the construction of a structure. For more information about roles 
and responsibilities and their interconnections, see Annex B 
‘Preconditions’, paragraph 2.  
6.4  New roles 
As soon as passports with sufficient content are more widely 
accessible, new user groups will emerge. New (possibly user group 
roles) will be: Management, Financial services, Consultancy services 
(marketplace for information) and Storage. For more in-depth 
information about the new roles, see Annex B ‘Preconditions’, 
paragraph 3. 
6.5 Building Information Model (BIM) 
Plenty of information, specifically geometric information, is recorded in 
BIM models during the design and production phases. The primary 
function of BIM models is to record the spatial information and 
quantities for the construction process. Most BIM models do not 
contain detailed information on products and their interrelationships 
(e.g. detachability). This is where the aspect of ‘linked data’ comes into 
play: the product information and its circular characteristics can now 
be linked to the BIM model. This then all comes together in the 
passport.
